papers.title_en: MailRail: Mitigating Incast Congestion with User-Space, Node-Based Flow Control
papers.authors: Noel Gomillion, Lance Fletcher, Trevor Steil, Eun Jung Kim, Roger Pearce
papers.evidence: 面向大规模并行环境的用户态节点级信用流控缓解Incast拥塞
papers.tldr: 1对抗性incast下相较无约束执行最高加速1132倍，均匀负载开销很小。该工作为高进程密度场景提供可扩展的主动拥塞控制方案。
papers.abstract_en: Irregular workloads, such as those stemming from Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, frequently induce severe incast congestion in large-scale parallel environments. Existing fabric-level congestion control mechanisms rely on reactive, link-level rate limiting that degrades overall throughput. While receiver-driven, credit-based flow control offers a proactive alternative, as process counts scale memory slots per rank fall below usable thresholds, rendering traditional rank-based accounting untenable. To address this challenge, we introduce MailRail, an out-of-order, asynchronous messaging framework, along with a novel user-space, node-based credit flow control system. By shifting credit accounting from individual processes to shared per-node pools, our proactive, fabric-agnostic approach maintains sufficient credit availability even as process density grows, enabling processes to dynamically utilize freed credits without waiting for receiver-side redistribution. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that node-based flow control achieves up to a 1132x speedup over unconstrained execution at an adversarial incast ratio of 4096:1 while adding minimal overhead on uniform workloads.

papers.title_en: SigmaTrace: Library-Agnostic Observability for CPU/GPU-Initiated RDMA Communication
papers.evidence: 面向CPU/GPU发起RDMA通信的细粒度剖析
papers.tldr: RDMA在大型系统中提供低延迟高带宽通信，但可观测性不足，现有工具依赖特定通信库或只报告聚合数据，GPU发起的网络操作更是对主机不可见。SigmaTrace是一个与库无关的RDMA剖析框架，在libibverbs/mlx5dv层追踪CPU与GPU发起的逐操作行为，并用低开销内存插桩首次实现无需改源码或二进制插桩的GPU发起RDMA观测。其在128 GPU NCCL AllReduce上开销仅1.3%，1024 GPU RCCL上低于2%，还揭示了现有剖析器看不到的内核内屏障扩散与2.13倍跨节点流量偏斜。
papers.abstract_en: RDMA networking enables low-latency, high-bandwidth communication on large systems. Despite its adoption, however, observability is lacking. Existing tools target specific communication libraries or only report aggregated data, missing per-operation behavior. The gap is widest for GPU-initiated networking, whose in-kernel RDMA operations are invisible to the host.   We present SigmaTrace, a library-agnostic RDMA profiling framework providing fine-grained, per-operation visibility for CPU and GPU-initiated networking. It traces operations at the libibverbs/mlx5dv layers, the common denominator beneath communication libraries on InfiniBand and RoCE, and employs a low-overhead memory interposition technique that, to our knowledge, gives the first observability into GPU-initiated RDMA without source patching or binary instrumentation.   Host-side tracing adds 1.3% overhead on NCCL AllReduce at 128 GPUs and under 2% on RCCL at 1024 GPUs. On a persistent-kernel BFS and Mixture-of-Experts inference, SigmaTrace exposes an in-kernel barrier spread and 2.13x inter-node traffic skew invisible to existing profilers.

papers.title_en: Improved Approximations for Coflow Scheduling via Iterated Rounding and Stable Matchings
papers.authors: Mikhail Cherniavskii, Arseni Fedorovich, Mikhail Koshelev, Andrey Kupavskii, Stanislav Moiseev, Fedor Ozhegov, Alexander Shekhovtsov
papers.evidence: 面向数据中心Coflow调度的改进近似算法
papers.tldr: Coflow 调度是数据中心网络中的关键优化问题，已有近似比仍有改进空间。本文结合一种新的迭代取整方案与基于 Gale-Shapley 稳定匹配的 Galvin 列表边染色方法，设计确定性多项式时间算法。在无释放日期情形达到 2.77 近似比，在整数释放日期情形达到 3.17 近似比。结果优于此前 3.42 和 4.36 的保证，提升了该问题的理论近似性能。
papers.abstract_en: We study Coflow Scheduling, introduced by Chowdhury, Zhong, and Stoica (2014). We give deterministic polynomial-time algorithms achieving a $2.77$-approximation without release dates and a $3.17$-approximation with integer release dates. These improve the $3.42$ and $4.36$ guarantees of Rohwedder and Schnaars (2025).   Our approach combines two ideas: (1) a novel iterated rounding scheme, and (2) Galvin's list edge coloring method, which is based on the Gale--Shapley stable matching algorithm.

papers.authors: Seyyidahmed Lahmer, Daniel Seibel, Srijeet Basu, Arno Troch, Jayesh Badwaik, Subhomoy Bhattacharyya, Abubakr Nada, Debjyoti Bhattacharjee, Vinay Kumar Baapanapalli Yadaiah, Michael Peeters, Andreas Herten, Darayus Adil Patel
papers.evidence: 面向集合通信HPC/AI网络仿真器的校准方法
papers.tldr: 针对HPC/AI网络仿真器校准与验证缺乏原则性方法的问题，CALIPER区分可直接观测参数与需校准的辅助参数，并将后者约束在目标系统可行域内。它采用分层、尺度感知的校准流程，结合参数对齐、约束推断与独立验证。在Jülich最高64节点集合通信基准上，校准配置在scale-up与scale-out场景的平均预测误差低于5%。该工作表明分层约束校准能提升参数可辨识性与跨观测范围的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Network simulation plays an important role in HPC/AI system research by enabling exploration of network architectures, communication strategies, and system configurations at scales that may be impractical to study experimentally. Existing approaches to network simulator calibration and validation lack a principled methodology that combines parameter alignment, constrained inference, and independent validation for collective-centric HPC/AI networks. We present CALIPER, a methodology for systematic calibration and validation of HPC/AI network simulators. CALIPER distinguishes directly observable system parameters from auxiliary parameters which are configured via calibration and constrains the latter to feasible domains consistent with the target system. We evaluate CALIPER's hierarchical, scale-aware calibration and its effects on parameter identifiability and generalization using collective communication benchmarks on a reference system with up to 64-nodes at the Jülich Supercomputing Centre. Validation results show that the calibrated parameter configurations identified by CALIPER predict system performance with less than 5% mean errors across scale-up and scale-out network domains. CALIPER demonstrates that hierarchical, constrained calibration can produce simulator configurations whose predictive accuracy persists beyond the observations used for fitting.

papers.title_en: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
papers.authors: Guoxia Wang, Qianyue He, Siming Wu, Haoyang Xie, Qiwen Bao, Jinle Zeng, Jiabin Yang, Tian Wu, Dianhai Yu
papers.evidence: 多节点上下文并行下零通信的掩码定位，服务分布式训练
papers.tldr: 长上下文训练中，结构化注意力掩码与多节点上下文并行叠加，成为主要瓶颈。FlashMask-3 在 Hopper 上构建掩码感知的 TMA/WGMMA warp 专用内核，并将逐列稀疏掩码扩展为分布式版本：零通信掩码定位、稀疏感知负载均衡 HCC-IPO 与掩码驱动通信剪枝。单卡 H100 上较 FlashMask、FlexAttention、MagiAttention 提升 45–141%、34–71%、2–44% TFLOPs；上下文并行度 4–32 时吞吐提升 1.09–3.71 倍，118B MoE 128K 端到端训练吞吐提升 7.3–11.0%。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context training of large language and multimodal models couples structured attention masks (document, prefix-LM, share-question, sliding-window, block-sparse) with multi-node context parallelism, making the mask a dominant bottleneck. FlashMask's column-wise sparse mask compresses them from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n)$ via four query-axis boundary vectors, covering broad structured patterns. Implemented for Ampere GPUs, it neither exploits FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA warp-specialized pipeline on Hopper nor supports distribution. The column-wise sparse mask is indexed by key positions but stores query-axis interval boundaries. Under any multi-chunk context-parallel assignment, it reduces per-rank mask localization to a provably zero-communication \emph{clip--shift--max} on the boundary vectors, compatible with the single-GPU kernel. FlashMask-3 introduces a mask-aware Hopper kernel with three-role warp specialization atop FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA pipeline, plus a mask-aware distributed extension: zero-communication mask localization, a sparsity-aware load balancer (HCC-IPO), and a mask-aware compute-communication overlap with mask-driven communication pruning, whose forward all-gather uses topology-aware hierarchical routing. On a single H100 across 12 masks at 4K--128K context, it improves achieved TFLOPs over FlashMask, FlexAttention, and MagiAttention by 45--141%, 34--71%, and 2--44%. At context-parallel degrees 4--32 with 8K sequence per device, it attains 31--75% compute-communication overlap efficiency and improves throughput over Megatron-Core CP ring, Megatron-Core CP all-gather, and MagiAttention by $1.80\times$--$3.71\times$, $1.71\times$--$2.92\times$, and $1.09\times$--$1.46\times$. In end-to-end training of a 118B-A14B MoE at 128K on 128 H100 GPUs, it raises throughput by 7.3--11.0% over a Dual Chunk all-gather baseline, with attention forward+backward 24.5--44.9% faster.

papers.title_en: Triple Overlap in Pipelined Krylov Methods on Multi-GPU Systems
papers.authors: Sinan Ekmekçibaşı, James D. Trotter, Johannes Langguth, Xing Cai, Didem Unat
papers.evidence: 在多GPU系统上通过集合通信库重叠集合通信、点对点通信与计算内核
papers.tldr: 针对多GPU上流水线Krylov求解器通信与计算重叠不足的问题，本文提出三重重叠实现，使集合通信、不规则点对点通信与计算核并发执行。方法覆盖Pipe-PCG与Pipe-BiCGStab，并在H100/A100超算上与PETSc及双流NCCL基线对比。结果显示三流设计在64 GPU上较双流基线几何平均加速1.23–1.33倍，大规模最高提速35%/33%，对PETSc最高3.27倍。该工作扩展了计算—通信—通信重叠，为多GPU科学计算提供可复现代码。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel triple-overlap implementation of the pipelined preconditioned conjugate gradient (Pipe-PCG) and pipelined stabilized biconjugate gradient (Pipe-BiCGStab) solvers, methods widely used in scientific applications. By leveraging a collective communication library, our approach extends conventional computation-communication overlap to concurrently execute collective operations, irregular P2P communication, and compute kernels, enabling computation-communication-communication overlap across multiple GPUs. We evaluate the design on the MareNostrum 5 (H100) and Leonardo (A100) supercomputers, comparing against PETSc and the state-of-the-art two-stream NCCL implementation using SuiteSparse matrices and three massive instances scaled up to 512 GPUs. The three-stream design outperforms the two-stream baseline on every instance, with the margin widening from 2-6% at 4 GPUs to 18-47% at 64 GPUs. At 64 GPUs, the geometric-mean speedup over the two-stream baseline is 1.33x on MareNostrum 5 and 1.23x on Leonardo for Pipe-PCG, and reaches 1.30x for Pipe-BiCGStab. In large-scale experiments, we observed a speedup up to 35% in Pipe-PCG and up to 33% in Pipe-BiCGStab compared to the two-stream design. For PETSc, the margin is even wider, up to 3.27x speedup in both Pipe-PCG and Pipe-BiCGStab. Related code for the proposed method is available online: https://github.com/ParCoreLab/aCG

papers.title_en: An Information-Geometric Framework for OCS-Reconfigurable Interconnect Topology in Large-Scale AI Clusters
papers.evidence: 面向大规模 AI 集群的 OCS 可重构互连拓扑
papers.tldr: 针对大规模AI集群中OCS可重构互连的布线选择、对称性偏离与重配置难题，提出统一信息几何框架，将布线表示为度数多面体上的概率单纯形，并以相对Fat-Tree先验的KL散度度量偏离。用平滑DAG关键路径成本构造自由能，给出适定性与对称性原则，并设计熵近端梯度乘法更新。时变流量下采用阈值策略与GLR-CUSUM检测，获得遗憾界，实验在流水线、数据与MoE负载上验证。
papers.abstract_en: Optical Circuit Switches (OCS) make inter-pod wiring in AI clusters programmable, posing design questions on wiring choice, symmetry departure, and reconfigurations. We present a unified information-geometric framework to address these issues.A wiring is a point in a probability simplex over circuits within a degree polytope. Departure from a symmetric Fat-Tree prior $\mathbf{q}$ is measured by $\DKL(\cdot \,\|\, \mathbf{q})$. The cost $U$ is the smoothed DAG critical-path length, whose gradient equals path marginals of a Gibbs distribution via forward--backward recursion.For free energy $F_{β_1} = U + β_1^{-1} \DKL(\cdot \,\|\, \mathbf{q})$, we prove well-posedness, monotonic dependence on $β_1$, adaptation bounds via Jeffreys divergence, and a symmetry principle for static optimality. An entropic proximal-gradient method updates multiplicatively with a $|V|$-dim dual KL projection, achieving linear convergence.For time-varying traffic, a threshold policy yields regret $O(\sqrt{ΓC V_1 T})$ against the switching-free optimum. Traffic changes are detected by a multinomial GLR--CUSUM detector with non-asymptotic false-alarm bounds. Multi-job generalized-mean fairness aligns with $α$-fairness ($α\ge 2$). Experiments on pipeline, data, and MoE workloads validate the framework against integer programming.
